quote: The positive component of Mental Health Literacy (PMeHL) refers to a person’s awareness of how to achieve and maintain good mental health.
The positive component of Mental Health Literacy (PMeHL) refers to a person’s awareness of how to achieve and maintain good mental health.
Mental health literacy consists of components related to the knowledge and abilities necessary to benefit mental health ( Jorm, 2012 ; Kutcher et al., 2016b ).

Mental Health Literacy (MHL) is an evolving concept, originally conceptualized by Jorm et al. (1997) (Wei et al., 2015 ; Bjørnsen et al., 2017 ) and today recognized as a determinant of a population’s mental health ( Jorm, 2012 ; Wei et al., 2013 ; Kutcher et al., 2016a ; Bröder et al., 2017 ).
From the perspective of Walker and Avant (2019) , defining attributes are critical characteristics that help differentiate related concepts and clarify their meaning.
Antecedents are the events or attributes that must exist prior to the occurrence of a concept ( Walker and Avant, 2019 ).
According to Walker and Avant (2019) , a borderline case contains most of the defining attributes but not all of them.
Empirical referents are measurable indicators of the concept’s occurrence ( Walker and Avant, 2019 ).
